title: boerhavia diffusa var. minor
intro: Boerhavia diffusa var. minor, commonly known as Red Spotted Spreading Hogweed, is a plant species that belongs to the Nyctaginaceae family. It is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antidiabetic properties. The therapeutic actions of Boerhavia diffusa var. minor include its ability to lower blood sugar levels, reduce fever, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which have been shown to have potential therapeutic effects in various studies.
